content.title: SnapLogic Manager — Control Plane
content.content:
The SnapLogic Manager is the cloud-hosted control plane providing the Designer UI, metadata repository, scheduling engine, and audit logging. For {{customer_name}}'s deployment, the Manager handles only metadata — never customer data.

**Key Manager Functions:**

**Pipeline Designer**: Web-based visual canvas for building integration pipelines using drag-and-drop Snaps (connectors and transformations)

**Metadata Repository**: Centralized storage for pipeline definitions, Snap configurations, project structure, and RBAC policies

**Scheduling & Orchestration**: Cron-based scheduling, triggered execution, and API-initiated pipeline runs. Schedules are stored in Manager; execution happens in Ground Plex

**User Authentication & RBAC**: SSO integration (SAML 2.0), MFA support, role-based access control for Orgs, Projects, and pipelines

**Audit Logging**: Immutable audit trail of user actions, pipeline executions, data lineage, and system events

**Dashboard & Analytics**: Real-time visibility into pipeline execution status, error rates, data volumes, and Ground Plex health

**SnapGPT AI Assistant**: Natural language pipeline generation, intelligent Snap recommendations, and pipeline optimization suggestions

**Manager-to-Ground-Plex Communication:**

- Ground Plex initiates outbound HTTPS connection to Manager
- Manager sends pipeline definitions, schedules, and configuration
- Ground Plex sends execution status, logs, and metrics back to Manager
- No customer data transmitted in either direction

**Data Sovereignty for {{customer_name}}:**

All customer data remains within {{customer_name}}'s infrastructure. The Manager sees only:
- Pipeline execution status (success, failure, warning)
- Execution duration and record counts (aggregate metrics, not actual data)
- Error messages and stack traces (no PII or sensitive data)
- User authentication events and RBAC configuration

The Manager never sees:
- Actual customer data being processed
- Database query results or API responses
- File contents or message payloads
- Connector credentials (stored encrypted in Ground Plex)
